summary: The article accurately reports Servotech Renewable Power System's Q1 FY27 financial results and India's renewable energy targets, citing a reliable financial news source and aligning with government goals.

claims.claim: Servotech Renewable Power System reported a significant 57.7% year-on-year (YoY) increase in revenue for Q1 FY27.
claims.note: Livemint reports a 57.7% YoY increase in consolidated revenue from operations for Q1 FY27.

claims.claim: The company's total revenue stood at ₹216.29 crore for the quarter ending June 30, 2026.
claims.note: Livemint states consolidated revenue from operations was ₹216.29 crore for Q1 FY27.

claims.claim: Gross profit saw an even stronger surge, rising 86.8% YoY to reach ₹48.56 crore.
claims.note: Livemint reports gross profit increased by 86.75% to ₹48.56 crore in Q1 FY27.

claims.claim: Profit After Tax (PAT) grew by a robust 74.5% YoY, amounting to ₹7.94 crore.
claims.note: Livemint confirms PAT grew by 74.5% YoY to ₹7.94 crore.

claims.claim: India aims to achieve 500 GW of non-fossil fuel energy capacity by 2030, with solar energy playing a pivotal role.
claims.note: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) of the Government of India confirms the target of 500 GW non-fossil energy capacity by 2030.

claims.claim: Official financial results for publicly listed companies in India are typically available on the stock exchange websites (BSE and NSE) and on the company's own investor relations section on their website. They are filed with SEBI.
claims.note: SEBI is the regulatory body for the securities market in India, and companies file their financial results with SEBI.

article_title: Servotech Renewable Power System Q1: PAT Jumps 75%, Revenue Up 58%
